payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_view_server.py::test_a_task_page_shows_failure_lines_capped_with_a_count_of_the_rest stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'Every failure line of the attempt is listed under each of its results.' applied to saffron/view/server.py as an edit. The claim was "Directly under each gate-result row whose `failureCount` is above 0, the task page lists that result's failure lines. They are the first `FAILURE_LINE_CAP` rows, 200, of `SELECT file, line, code, message FROM failures WHERE gate_result_id = ? ORDER BY failure_id`. Each is one row of four cells in that order. When the result has more, one further row holds the single cell `<N> more`. The gate result id is parsed from `data:gate-result-<gate_result_id>`. The witness drives a result with 205 failures, one with exactly 200 and one with 3 in a later attempt. Their files and lines run opposite to `failure_id`.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
